plan.purpose: R109 independent randomized-slot confirmation vs stock
plan.statistical_unit: One ratio per physical paired window; 20 equal-size serial segments per side are aggregated. Ten independent router windows; segments are not independent replicates.
plan.preflight: 35 physical unit tests and seven C/accepted/R109 wire differentials passed. Canonical-path release rebuild byte-identical. Complete ABBA heap diagnostic before starting CPU series.
plan.production: stock C throughout; only new disposable namespace processes are pinned; no governor/IRQ/production affinity changes
plan.failure_rule: Stop on identity, correctness, collection, health, affinity or cleanup failure. Preserve failed window; never infer success from missing results.
plan.design: Ten independent paired physical windows, 40 serial segments per window, 10000 timed cycles plus 2000 warmup per segment. Five candidate-a and five candidate-b assignments in seeded shuffled order. Two comparator windows per block in seeded shuffled order. Daemons CPU1, caller CPU0. Slot roles are fixed per driver (a=baseline, b=candidate); quartet order and comparator order are randomized. This avoids an analyzer/driver role ambiguity; role effects are handled by ABBA/BAAB within each window.
plan.previous_data: R109 fixed-slot 10-window pilot preserved separately. Do not pool with it or any prior round.
plan.comparison_family: Two comparators x four metrics; 8 planned exact median rank intervals.
plan.slot_semantics: The runner uploads the logical slot b ELF as candidate and slot a ELF as before-candidate. The workload starts slot a on the first daemon and slot b on the second, so process roles are randomized by block. implementation=rs is only the upload path.
plan.interpretation_rule: Registration 1-method/8-byte-name only. Daemon and total CPU intervals below 1 support improvement in this condition. Report caller CPU and wall intervals even when unresolved. No source promotion without broader workloads, memory and compatibility. Unresolved sub-percent effects are not regressions or equivalence.

limits: One independent ratio per physical window; segments are not independent. Exact image C caller; R109 vs exact C daemon only. No whole-component or memory conclusion.
